lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's four pi? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 4π? Nope!

lines.text: A square of side one rolls clockwise around a fixed square of side two.
lines.caption: A square of side 1 rolls clockwise around a fixed square of side 2.

lines.text: How long is the path of corner P, until it's first back home?
lines.caption: How long is the path of corner P, until it's first back home?

lines.text: Along a side: a quarter turn, with radius one.
lines.caption: Along a side: a quarter turn, with radius 1.

lines.text: At a corner: a HALF turn, with radius root two!
lines.caption: At a corner: a HALF turn, with radius √2!

lines.text: Another quarter turn. Then P IS the pivot: zero!
lines.caption: Another quarter turn. Then P IS the pivot: 0!

lines.text: The other half repeats the same four moves.
lines.caption: The other half repeats the same 4 moves.

lines.text: Add it all up: two plus two root two, all times pi!
lines.caption: Add it all up: 2 + 2√2, all times π!

lines.text: Four pi was the trap: the wrong radius!
lines.caption: 4π was the trap: the wrong radius!

lines.text: Did you get Choice C? Tell me below!
